import ast
from fractions import Fraction

# Geographic propositions used in the question:
Armenia_Yerevan = True
Canada_Ottawa = True
Colombia_Bogota = True
Afghanistan_Kabul = True
Nigeria_Lagos = False  # Nigeria's capital is Abuja.

expressions = {
    "A": """
not (not not (not (not not (-3 - (-5 / 3) > 10) or not not not (max(7, -4, -10, -9) - min(7, -4, -10, -9) <= 10)) or (not not not (max(-1, 5, 6, 9) - min(-1, 5, 6, 9) > 10) and not not (10 - (3 / -7) > 1))) or not not not (not not not (not (False) and (False)) and not not (not (False) and (8 * 3 > 3)))) and (not not ((not not (max(-1, 6, -4, 6) - min(-1, 6, -4, 6) <= 6) or not not not (Armenia_Yerevan)) and (not not (max(-10, -7, 10, -2) - min(-10, -7, 10, -2) <= 3) or not not not (-4 * 6 + -7 * -4 > -10 * 2))) or not not not ((not not not (False) and not not (max(6, 2, 1, -3) - min(6, 2, 1, -3) > 3)) or (not not (False) or not not not (-8 * 9 + -8 * -1 <= -10 * -1))))
""",
    "B": """
not not not (((not (not (not not not ((not (not ((max(-10, 9, 8, -7) - min(-10, 9, 8, -7) <= 6) or (False)) or (Canada_Ottawa)) or (1 - (2 / -10) > -5)) and (9 * 4 > 9)) and not not (True)) or (10 - (3 / 2) <= 10)) or (5 * 7 <= -6)) or (-1 * 4 + -4 * 2 <= -2 * 6)) or (-5 - (9 / 9) > 5)) and not not (-1 * 10 + 3 * 10 <= 5 * -10)
""",
    "C": """
not not (not ((True) or (True)) and (not not (False) or not not not (max(-1, 8, -4, -5) - min(-1, 8, -4, -5) <= 3))) or not not not ((not (False) or (8 - (-6 / -1) <= 5)) or (not not not (False) and not not (-1 - (-6 / 1) > 9)))
""",
    "D": """
not not not (((not ((not not not (((not (not (not (Armenia_Yerevan) and (max(-4, -4, -8, -6) - min(-4, -4, -8, -6) > 1)) and (Colombia_Bogota)) and (Afghanistan_Kabul)) or (-3 * 6 > 6)) and (Nigeria_Lagos)) and not not (True)) or (True)) or (5 * -10 > -2)) and (4 - (-8 / -6) <= 4)) and (7 * -9 + 9 * 6 > -4 * -8)) and not not (Afghanistan_Kabul)
""",
    "E": """
not (not not not ((True) or (7 - (-7 / -9) > 8)) and not not (not not (4 * -3 + -6 * 6 <= 10 * -7) or not not not (False))) and (not not not ((-5 - (2 / 6) > 10) or (-2 - (-5 / 2) > -5)) and not not (not (max(-2, 1, 7, -5) - min(-2, 1, 7, -5) > 5) and (False)))
""",
}


class ExactDivision(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def visit_BinOp(self, node):
        node = self.generic_visit(node)
        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Div):
            return ast.copy_location(
                ast.Call(
                    func=ast.Name(id="Fraction", ctx=ast.Load()),
                    args=[node.left, node.right],
                    keywords=[],
                ),
                node,
            )
        return node


environment = {
    "__builtins__": {},
    "Fraction": Fraction,
    "min": min,
    "max": max,
    "Armenia_Yerevan": Armenia_Yerevan,
    "Canada_Ottawa": Canada_Ottawa,
    "Colombia_Bogota": Colombia_Bogota,
    "Afghanistan_Kabul": Afghanistan_Kabul,
    "Nigeria_Lagos": Nigeria_Lagos,
}

results = {}
for label, expression in expressions.items():
    tree = ast.parse(expression.strip(), mode="eval")
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(ExactDivision().visit(tree))
    result = eval(compile(tree, "<expression>", "eval"), environment)
    if type(result) is not bool:
        raise TypeError("Expression did not evaluate to a Boolean")
    results[label] = result
    print(f"{label} = {result}")

true_options = [label for label, value in results.items() if value]
submitted = "C"
print("True options:", ", ".join(true_options) or "none")
print(f"Submitted {submitted} evaluates to {results[submitted]}")
print("CHECK PASS" if true_options == [submitted] else "CHECK FAIL")
